mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, it is 77 degrees with clear skies at Verona City Hall. The moon is currently in its first quarter phase, and if you are up early, you can catch the space station visible at 3:23 AM, rising over Belleville and traveling toward Fitchburg while remaining low near the horizon.

The City of Verona has two important updates. The Department of Public Works is hiring an Engineering Technician with a deadline of September 20. Also, the city has implemented new sewer and stormwater utility rates to maintain infrastructure and prevent issues like sewer backups or flooding, with the average home seeing an increase of about 26 dollars per quarter.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today, you can catch Concerts in the Park or head over to Hop Haus for trivia. Tomorrow, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, and look forward to the Dane County Farmer's Market this Friday.

In our weekly report, on August 15, officers encountered a 44-year-old woman who was found passed out behind the wheel near North Main Street and Cross Country Road. She was eventually arrested for a first offence O W I after initially driving away when officers attempted to wake her.
The Culver's flavor of the day is the delightful Chocolate Heath Crunch. They are open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by and grab a scoop.
